goal: Gemini commits on gemini-q/<id> branches only and never ships (gemini_queue.py). For each of the 11 cards run on JIS-NUC task gq15 (gemini-jala-method-extract, gemini-cbp-altcoin-buy-plan, gemini-krown-ta101-extract-missing-4, gemini-pizzino-spec-vs-method-blind-check, gemini-review-gpt-formula-audits-1030, gemini-param-labels-live-aid-analyst-levels, gemini-doc-contradiction-scan-v1-plan, gemini-blind-read-layer-review-sheets, gemini-malkan-top12-rsi-rules-extract, gemini-krown-setups-beyond-ta101, gemini-cryptocred-stop-buffer-source-hunt): fetch the branch, run the verifier, spot-check 3 quotes against the transcript, merge what passes, tasks.py done with the count, ship once.
